# Project Context: Mobile Hiking Trail App

This is a mobile web application that simulates a hiking trail app with badges, leaderboards, and family profiles. The app is designed to be viewed on desktop but has a mobile-like appearance.

## Project Structure
- HTML: index.html - Main structure of the app with all screens
- CSS: css/styles.css - Styling for the mobile interface
- JavaScript: js/app.js - Handles navigation and interactivity
- Images: img/ - Contains app assets (currently empty)

## Design Guidelines
- Keep the mobile-first approach
- Use the existing color scheme defined in CSS variables
- Maintain the navigation pattern with the bottom nav bar
- Follow the screen layouts as shown in the original screenshot

## Features to Consider
- Home screen with family information
- Map screen with interactive trails
- Trail history with detailed information
- AR view with quest information
- Rewards/badges system with leaderboard
- Family profile with statistics
